title: Amphi: Practical and Intelligent Data Prefetching for the First-Level Cache
problem: First-level cache prefetchers must balance comprehensive pattern coverage through ML with strict resource constraints, while existing ML prefetchers are deployed only at last-level cache.
motivation: Memory wall remains critical performance bottleneck; practical L1 intelligent prefetching can improve performance without excessive resource overhead.
method: Amphi applies binarized temporal convolutional network (TCN) for L1 prefetching prediction, reducing storage from ~27 KB (Pythia) to 3.4 KB while maintaining performance parity.
key_novelty: First practical ML-based prefetcher specifically designed for first-level cache using binarized neural networks.
contributions: Binarized TCN architecture for L1 prefetch prediction
Storage reduction to 3.4 KB (8× more efficient than Pythia)
Performance comparable to SOTA intelligent prefetchers
Practical deployment model for L1 cache integration
limitations: Evaluation limited to L1 cache; detailed latency metrics not provided.
